messages.subject: Error deploying app: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 14397 error:
parts:
Hi all, 

I successfully deployed two smaller apps, but got an error when deploying a more complex app that does some mapping. When I deployed this app to glimmer previously, I needed to get rgdal and external dependencies installed for package plotKML on the glimmer server, so this may be a problem here as well.

The full error: 

Waiting for task: 14396
  building: Parsing manifest
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 14397 error: Unhandled Exception: Expected W:(abcd...) (at char 0), (line:1, col:1)

By the way, ShinyApps is stunning simple to use. Love it already. 

Thanks for your help.
Are

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error deploying app: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 14397 error:
parts:
Are,

I noticed that your application requires the RSAGA package (which is imported by the plotKML package). According to the description for this package the RSAGA package requires the SAGA-GIS OS library to be installed. ShinyApps does not currently support installing OS libraries, though this is a feature we are looking at adding soon.

Regardless, I've just deployed a fix for the error you were getting. Feel free to try to run deployApp() again, but I suspect you will get an error building RSAGA.

-Andy
